title: Protect the origin when freshness expires
description: Inject a slowdown, outage, or invalidation storm. Change grace and duplicate-miss handling to see whether clients receive bounded stale content or an overloaded origin path.

scenarios.label: Healthy origin
scenarios.detail: Normal misses and refreshes complete with available capacity.

scenarios.label: Origin slowdown
scenarios.detail: A dependency slowdown reduces useful origin capacity and increases refresh latency.

scenarios.label: Origin unavailable
scenarios.detail: Connections fail; only an eligible stale object can preserve a successful response.

scenarios.label: Fleet-wide invalidation
scenarios.detail: A broad purge makes most popular objects cold at the same moment.

collapsePolicies.label: Independent duplicate misses
collapsePolicies.detail: Every modeled request for the expired object starts equivalent origin work.

collapsePolicies.label: Collapse duplicate misses
collapsePolicies.detail: One request refreshes an object while equivalent waiters reuse the result or receive grace.

notice: The arithmetic illustrates causality rather than predicting production capacity. Validate grace, keep, request coalescing, backend probes, timeouts, and invalidation behavior under representative traffic.
